import base64
from llama_index.core.base.llms.types import ImageBlock

# 1x1 png
png = bytes.fromhex('89504e470d0a1a0a0000000d49484452000000010000000108060000001f15c4890000000d49444154789c626001000000ffff03000006000557bfabd40000000049454e44ae426082')

b = ImageBlock(image=png)
assert b.encoding == 'base64'
assert b.image == base64.b64encode(png)
assert b.resolve_image().read() == png
assert b.resolve_image(as_base64=True).read() == base64.b64encode(png)
assert b.get_image_mimetype() == 'image/png'

r = ImageBlock(image=png, encoding='raw')
assert r.image == png
assert r.resolve_image().read() == png
assert r.resolve_image(as_base64=True).read() == base64.b64encode(png)
assert r.get_image_mimetype() == 'image/png'
print('OK')
"
